limits: 21 unit cases and 4 cases in the full browser sweep were skipped. Three skipped candidate-HTTP cases passed separately with the actual isolated API report; the extra accepted669 baseline comparison was unavailable. No success is attributed to skipped executions.
The complete source browser suite uses deterministic fixtures; mocked payouts are not new on-chain payments.

Live X OAuth and X publishing were not executed; no X posts were sent. Paid Pro/Premier package burns, listing and boost writes were not freshly executed through the public UI; their fixtures and existing receipts are separate evidence.
Normal time, funding and market-cap gates were preserved. Fresh migration/airdrop, holder/bonus payouts and agent buybacks were not forced or re-executed for the new UI token.
The earlier 93-transaction / 33-payment financial campaign remains separate evidence. This run freshly rechecked one historical protocol burn and the six recorded collection/settlement proofs.
Redis remained enabled and healthy; API-credit savings were not remeasured or attributed to this UI run.
